description: Files one period of HMRC's Self Employment Business API (derive_itsa_quarterly_update's figures, once the user has confirmed them) over the deployed API. In a tax year filed as cumulative period summaries (2025-26 on) the figures are the running total from 6 April and the period dates are optional; in earlier years they are required. Uses the session's HMRC authorisation for the itsa service: call request_hmrc_authorisation with services ["itsa"] first if this tool says none is held.

businessId.description: The self-employment business id HMRC holds, for example XAIS12345678901

hmrcAccount.description: Which HMRC environment to call; defaults to the session's HMRC authorisation's own

periodDisallowableExpenses.description: Disallowable expenses by field, as derive_itsa_quarterly_update answers it

periodExpenses.description: Expenses by field, as derive_itsa_quarterly_update answers it

periodIncome.description: Income by field, as derive_itsa_quarterly_update answers it

name: submit_itsa_quarterly_update
title: Submit an ITSA quarterly update
